summary: Full test suite run: 1109 tests passed (36 files), 0 failures. api.test.ts confirms 58 tests — 2 new same-slug cases included and green.

Code review: SlugConflictError class correctly exported from ledger-store.ts with name property set in constructor. renameSlug() throws SlugConflictError (not plain Error) for the target-directory conflict case — verified against the SlugConflictError throw at line 357.

handleRenameProject same-slug pre-check (api.ts L685-688) correctly short-circuits renameSlug() when newSlug === slug, materialising latestMeta via readProjectMeta() instead. Catch block uses instanceof SlugConflictError (L692) — string-prefix matching fully removed.

summary: Code review PASS. Three files modified cleanly: ledger-store.ts, gui/api.ts, tests/gui/api.test.ts. All 7 acceptance criteria met.

SlugConflictError (ledger-store.ts L20-25): Well-formed custom error class — extends Error, sets this.name = 'SlugConflictError' in constructor for reliable instanceof checks across transpilation boundaries. Exported as a named export. JSDoc is accurate.

renameSlug() (ledger-store.ts L344-379): Defensive same-slug guard retained as a backstop (line 351). The access()/ENOENT pattern is the established idiom for this codebase; conflict case correctly throws SlugConflictError. JSDoc stale-instance warning is preserved and accurate.
api.ts import (L21): Correct named import of SlugConflictError alongside LedgerStore from '../src/storage/ledger-store.js'.

handleRenameProject same-slug pre-check (api.ts L686-688): Clean idiom — `latestMeta ??= await store.readProjectMeta()` short-circuits when newSlug === slug without touching disk. Ordering (title-first, slug-second) preserved. The Zod refine guard guarantees latestMeta is always defined before the non-null assertion on return.
Catch block (api.ts L691-695): instanceof SlugConflictError replaces fragile string-prefix matching. Unconditional re-throw for all other errors is correct and maintains error transparency.

Tests (api.test.ts L658-690): Both new tests are structurally sound. 'same-slug no-op' asserts HTTP 200, unchanged metadata, and directory existence. 'combined title + same-slug no-op' asserts title mutation and last_updated immutability. No spy needed — the access() check adequately proves no rename occurred.

comments.note: ledger-store.ts L351: The defensive same-slug guard inside renameSlug() throws a plain Error (not SlugConflictError). This guard is intentionally unreachable from the API handler now that the pre-check sits upstream. A brief inline comment — e.g. '// defensive guard: upstream handler should prevent this branch' — would clarify intent for future maintainers and avoid confusion during any future refactor.

api.ts L701: The non-null assertion `latestMeta!` is safe because the Zod .refine() guarantees at least one branch ran, but a brief inline comment referencing the .refine() constraint would make this a self-documenting assertion rather than an unexplained TypeScript suppression. Already partially addressed by the existing inline comment — no action required.

No renameSlug spy in the same-slug no-op test. The access() directory check is a valid behavioural proxy, but a vi.spyOn on the store instance for renameSlug would make the no-call assertion explicit. Low priority — current coverage is sufficient.
